title: Descent of bounded finitely presented complex data
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (S_i)_{i\in I} be an inverse system of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, where S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) for Noetherian rings R_i, and let S=\varprojlim_i S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R). Fix i\in I, let X_i be a finitely presented S_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme], put X=X_i\times_{S_i}S and X_j=X_i\times_{S_i}S_j for j\ge i [def-pc-base-change]. Let G^\bullet mean a Z-indexed family of finitely presented quasi-coherent \mathcal{O}_X-modules [pqf-def-coherent], zero outside a finite interval, with \mathcal{O}_X-linear differentials d^r:G^r\to G^{r+1} satisfying d^{r+1}\circ d^r=0. Then, after replacing i by some j\ge i, there is such a bounded family H_j^\bullet of finitely presented quasi-coherent \mathcal{O}_{X_j}-modules and differentials whose base change to X is isomorphic to G^\bullet as a complex.

proof.text: Use bounded_graded_module_map_descent on G.X and the successive differentials G.d n (n+1), retaining the fixed bounds a,b. This gives common models F, maps delta and comparison isomorphisms e, without square-zero relations.

Conjugate the base-changed composites delta_n delta_{n+1} through e_{n+2}. Naturality of the map comparisons and G.d_comp_d show that they vanish. Enumerate n in [a,b] by Fin(card N), and all source and target degrees by the finite lifted interval [a,b+2]. Apply finiteRelation_module_map_descent to these composites and zero.

Pull F and delta to the stage supplied by finite relation descent. The enumerated squares are zero there; outside [a,b] the source F_n is zero. Functoriality and preservation of zero maps give square-zero successive maps in every degree. CochainComplex.of builds H.

Pullback preserves the zero terms and finite presentations, hence boundedness and quasi-coherence. The cone equation identifies the composite baseChangeMap with the map to the original stage. Tensor pullback composition gives the new termwise isomorphisms; its naturality transfers the differential comparisons. For nonadjacent degrees both complex differentials vanish by shape.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finitelyPresented_complex_of_limit {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)] (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt] (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (G : CochainComplex (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules ℤ) (hG_bounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n)) (hG_fp : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFinitePresentation) (hG_qc : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsQuasicoherent) : ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (H : CochainComplex (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules ℤ), (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (H.X n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (H.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (H.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧ ∃ e : ∀ n : ℤ, (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i))) (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj (H.X n) ≅ G.X n, ∀ n m : ℤ, (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i))) (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).map (H.d n m) ≫ (e m).hom = (e n).hom ≫ G.d n m
